component.name: infinispan-embedded
component.title: Infinispan Embedded
component.description: Read and write the entries of caches of an Infinispan cache manager embedded in the application, and receive their events.
component.label: cache,clustering

configuration.description: The configuration of the component, which each endpoint copies and then changes with its own options. The cache manager of the component uses only this configuration.

queryBuilder.description: To use a custom org.apache.camel.component.infinispan.InfinispanQueryBuilder that builds the query of the QUERY operation of the producer, which the CamelInfinispanQueryBuilder header replaces. When set, the consumer registers a continuous query instead of a listener, and receives the CacheEntryJoining, CacheEntryUpdated and CacheEntryLeaving events of the entries that match the query.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

clusteredListener.label: consumer
clusteredListener.description: Whether the consumer registers its listener as an Infinispan clustered listener, which receives the events of the changes made on all the nodes of the cluster, not only on the local node. A clustered listener receives only the events after a change, and only for entries that are created, modified, removed or expired. Not used when customListener or queryBuilder is set.

customListener.label: consumer
customListener.description: To use a custom listener, a subclass of org.apache.camel.component.infinispan.embedded.InfinispanEmbeddedCustomListener annotated with the Infinispan Listener annotation, that the consumer registers on the cache in place of its own listener. The eventTypes, sync and clusteredListener options are not used then. Not used when queryBuilder is set.

eventTypes.label: consumer
eventTypes.description: The comma-separated names of the Infinispan event types that the consumer passes on to the route, for example CACHE_ENTRY_CREATED,CACHE_ENTRY_REMOVED. If not set, the consumer passes on all events. Its listener receives only the events of the types CACHE_ENTRY_ACTIVATED, CACHE_ENTRY_CREATED, CACHE_ENTRY_EXPIRED, CACHE_ENTRY_INVALIDATED, CACHE_ENTRY_LOADED, CACHE_ENTRY_MODIFIED, CACHE_ENTRY_PASSIVATED, CACHE_ENTRY_REMOVED and CACHE_ENTRY_VISITED. Not used when customListener or queryBuilder is set.

sync.label: consumer
sync.description: Whether Infinispan calls the listener of the consumer synchronously, so the cache operation that caused the event waits until the route has processed it. If false, Infinispan calls the listener in a thread of its own. Not used when customListener or queryBuilder is set.

defaultValue.label: producer
defaultValue.description: The value that the GETORDEFAULT operation returns when the key is not in the cache. The CamelInfinispanDefaultValue header replaces this option.

key.label: producer
key.description: The key of the entry for the producer operations that take a key, such as PUT, GET, REMOVE and COMPUTE. When set, it takes precedence over the CamelInfinispanKey header.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

oldValue.label: producer
oldValue.description: The value that the REPLACE and REPLACEASYNC operations compare with the current value of the entry, to replace the entry only if they are equal. If not set, an existing entry is replaced whatever its value. The CamelInfinispanOldValue header replaces this option.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelInfinispanOperation header replaces this option.

value.label: producer
value.description: The value of the entry for the PUT, PUTIFABSENT and REPLACE operations and their ASYNC variants, the value to look for with CONTAINSVALUE, and the value that REMOVE and REMOVEASYNC compare with the current value, to remove the entry only if they are equal. The CamelInfinispanValue header replaces this option.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

cacheContainer.label: advanced
cacheContainer.description: To use a custom org.infinispan.manager.EmbeddedCacheManager as the cache manager. When set or autowired, the cacheContainerConfiguration and configurationUri options are not used, and Camel does not stop the cache manager. Read on the component only, as the cache manager is shared by all the endpoints of the component: set on an endpoint, this option is not used.

cacheContainerConfiguration.label: advanced
cacheContainerConfiguration.description: The org.infinispan.configuration.cache.Configuration of the default cache, named default, of the cache manager that Camel creates when cacheContainer is not set. When set, configurationUri is not used. Read on the component only, as the cache manager is shared by all the endpoints of the component: set on an endpoint, this option is not used.

configurationUri.label: advanced
configurationUri.description: The location of the configuration file of the cache manager that Camel creates, read from the classpath unless it has a prefix such as file:. Not used when cacheContainer or cacheContainerConfiguration is set. For infinispan-embedded it is an Infinispan XML configuration file, read on the component only; for infinispan it is a Hot Rod client properties file.

flags.label: advanced
flags.description: A comma-separated list of names of org.infinispan.context.Flag, for example SKIP_CACHE_LOAD,SKIP_CACHE_STORE, that the endpoints apply to each cache that they use. Read on the component only, as the cache manager is shared by all the endpoints of the component: set on an endpoint, this option is not used.

remappingFunction.label: advanced
remappingFunction.description: The java.util.function.BiFunction that the COMPUTE and COMPUTEASYNC operations call with the key and the current value of the entry, or null if there is none, to compute its new value. If the function returns null, the entry is removed.

resultHeader.label: advanced
resultHeader.description: The name of the header in which the producer stores the result of the operation, keeping the message body. If not set, the result replaces the message body. The CamelInfinispanOperationResultHeader header replaces this option.

CamelInfinispanEventType.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanEventType.description: The type of the event that the consumer received: the name of the Infinispan event type, or CacheEntryJoining, CacheEntryUpdated or CacheEntryLeaving for a continuous query.

CamelInfinispanIsPre.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanIsPre.description: true if the notification is before the event has occurred, false if after the event has occurred.

CamelInfinispanCacheName.description: The name of the cache. The consumer sets it for each event, and for the producer it replaces the cache name of the endpoint.

CamelInfinispanKey.description: The key of the entry. The consumer sets it for each event that has one. The producer uses it for the operations that take a key, unless the key option is set.

CamelInfinispanValue.label: producer
CamelInfinispanValue.description: The value of the entry for the producer operations that take a value. It replaces the value option.

CamelInfinispanDefaultValue.label: producer
CamelInfinispanDefaultValue.description: The value that the GETORDEFAULT operation returns when the key is not in the cache. It replaces the defaultValue option.

CamelInfinispanOldValue.label: producer
CamelInfinispanOldValue.description: The value that the REPLACE and REPLACEASYNC operations compare with the current value of the entry, to replace the entry only if they are equal. It replaces the oldValue option. The consumer of infinispan-embedded sets it to the value of the removed entry for a CACHE_ENTRY_REMOVED event.

CamelInfinispanMap.label: producer
CamelInfinispanMap.description: The java.util.Map of the entries that the PUTALL and PUTALLASYNC operations store.

CamelInfinispanOperation.label: producer
CamelInfinispanOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelInfinispanOperationResult.label: producer
CamelInfinispanOperationResult.deprecationNote: Never set nor read by the component. Use CamelInfinispanOperationResultHeader to choose the header that carries the result of an operation.
CamelInfinispanOperationResult.description: The name of the header whose value is the result. Deprecation note: Never set nor read by the component. Use CamelInfinispanOperationResultHeader to choose the header that carries the result of an operation.

CamelInfinispanOperationResultHeader.label: producer
CamelInfinispanOperationResultHeader.description: The name of the header in which the producer stores the result of the operation, keeping the message body. It replaces the resultHeader option.

CamelInfinispanLifespanTime.label: producer
CamelInfinispanLifespanTime.description: The lifespan of the entry, after which it expires, for the PUT, PUTALL, PUTIFABSENT and REPLACE operations and their ASYNC variants. Only used together with the CamelInfinispanTimeUnit header. A negative value means that the entry does not expire.

CamelInfinispanTimeUnit.label: producer
CamelInfinispanTimeUnit.description: The java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit of the CamelInfinispanLifespanTime header.

CamelInfinispanMaxIdleTime.label: producer
CamelInfinispanMaxIdleTime.description: The maximum time that the entry can stay without being accessed before it expires, for the same operations as the CamelInfinispanLifespanTime header. Only used together with the CamelInfinispanMaxIdleTimeUnit header, and only when the CamelInfinispanLifespanTime and CamelInfinispanTimeUnit headers are set too.

CamelInfinispanMaxIdleTimeUnit.label: producer
CamelInfinispanMaxIdleTimeUnit.description: The java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit of the CamelInfinispanMaxIdleTime header.

CamelInfinispanIgnoreReturnValues.label: producer
CamelInfinispanIgnoreReturnValues.description: Whether the producer applies the Infinispan IGNORE_RETURN_VALUES flag to the cache, so that a write operation does not need to read the existing value from a cache store or from another node. The result of such an operation, for example the previous value for PUT, can then be null.

CamelInfinispanEventData.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanEventData.description: The value of the entry that the event is about, when the event carries one. For a continuous query, it is the value of the entry that joins the result or is updated.

CamelInfinispanQueryBuilder.label: producer
CamelInfinispanQueryBuilder.description: The org.apache.camel.component.infinispan.InfinispanQueryBuilder that builds the query of the QUERY operation. It replaces the queryBuilder option.

CamelInfinispanCommandRetried.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanCommandRetried.description: This will be true if the write command that caused this had to be retried again due to a topology change.

CamelInfinispanEntryCreated.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanEntryCreated.description: Indicates whether the cache entry modification event is the result of the cache entry being created.

CamelInfinispanOriginLocal.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanOriginLocal.description: true if the call originated on the local cache instance; false if originated from a remote one.

CamelInfinispanCurrentState.label: consumer
CamelInfinispanCurrentState.description: Whether Infinispan generated the event for an entry that already existed when the listener was registered, which it does only for a listener whose Listener annotation sets includeCurrentState to true.

consumerOut.description: No body: the event type, the cache name and the key of the entry are in headers, and the value, when the event has one, in the CamelInfinispanEventData header

producerIn.description: The body is not used: the key, the value and the Map for PUTALL come from the CamelInfinispanKey, CamelInfinispanValue and CamelInfinispanMap headers, or the key and value options

producerOut.description: The result of the operation, which the CamelInfinispanOperation header can set: the value for GET, or null when the key is not in the cache, the previous value for PUT, the default, a Boolean for CONTAINSKEY, an Integer for SIZE, a List for QUERY and a CompletableFuture for the ASYNC operations; PUTALL and CLEAR keep the body. With resultHeader the result goes to that header and the body is kept

cacheName.description: The name of the cache. The value current uses the default cache of the cache manager, and the default cache of a cache manager that Camel creates is named default. The CamelInfinispanCacheName header replaces this name for the producer.

exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.
